title: Binding of the Elastin Peptide VGVAPG and Lactose to the Human Elastin Binding Protein
authors: Zeynep Pinar Haslak; Nicolas Belloy; Laurent Debelle; Manuel Dauchez; Stéphanie Baud
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模、分子动力学模拟和分子对接研究弹性蛋白结合蛋白与肽段/乳糖的互作，虽属蛋白-配体结合机制建模，但对象为蛋白-肽/糖而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Elastin-derived peptides (EDPs) interact with elastin-binding protein (EBP), a key component of the elastin receptor complex, modulating cellular processes such as protease activation, apoptosis, and chemotaxis via regulation of NEU-1 sialidase activity. Despite their therapeutic relevance, the structural basis of EDP-EBP interactions remains poorly understood. Here, we present the first full-length homology model of EBP (residues 29-516), constructed and validated through duplicate 1 microsecond long molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Molecular docking of VGVAPG (as a representative EDP) and lactose (as a representative galactosugar) followed by MD simulations, allowed us to identify key binding residues: D98, E99, S104, and S136 for VGVAPG; and E99, S101, S104, N116, Q124, E137, and Y139 for lactose. These data reveal a shared binding region within residues 83-139, suggesting a competitive binding between EDPs and galactosugars. Furthermore, EBP residues P233 and I234 were implicated in potential interactions with PPCA or NEU-1, contributing to ERC assembly. These findings offer new insights into the molecular recognition mechanisms of EBP and provide a foundation for the design of EBP-targeted elastin peptide antagonists.
abstract_zh: 弹性蛋白衍生肽（EDPs）与弹性蛋白结合蛋白（EBP）相互作用，EBP是弹性蛋白受体复合物的关键组分，通过调节NEU-1唾液酸酶活性，调控蛋白酶激活、细胞凋亡和趋化等细胞过程。尽管具有治疗相关性，EDP-EBP相互作用的结构基础仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出了EBP（残基29-516）的首个全长同源模型，该模型通过重复的1微秒长分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟构建并验证。对VGVAPG（作为代表性EDP）和乳糖（作为代表性半乳糖）进行分子对接，随后进行MD模拟，使我们能够识别关键结合残基：VGVAPG的D98、E99、S104和S136；乳糖的E99、S101、S104、N116、Q124、E137和Y139。这些数据揭示了残基83-139内的共享结合区域，提示EDPs与半乳糖之间存在竞争性结合。此外，EBP残基P233和I234被涉及与PPCA或NEU-1的潜在相互作用，有助于ERC组装。这些发现为EBP的分子识别机制提供了新见解，并为设计靶向EBP的弹性蛋白肽拮抗剂奠定了基础。
